notes: TDPUD rates are bundled residential energy rates. The app stores them as generation with zero delivery component so combined equals the published bundled rate.
TDPUD residential TOU periods are the same every day: off-peak 9pm-11am, mid-peak 11am-4pm, peak 4pm-9pm.
Fixed-rate plans are non-TOU bundled energy rates. Monthly fixed/customer charges are not included in EV charging cost estimates.

TDPUD-TOU-PRIMARY.name: Residential TOU Primary
TDPUD-TOU-PRIMARY.description: Optional TDPUD residential time-of-use plan for primary residences.
TDPUD-TOU-PRIMARY.eligibility: TDPUD residential electric customers; customer may change rates once every 12 months.

fixedCharges.note: Monthly customer/fixed charges, if applicable, are not included in EV charging session estimates.
